title: Charles Daniel Webster and Adam Kramer, March 1929
location: 202 Luzerne Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland, United States
caption: Charles Daniel Webster (left) and Adam Kramer (right), photographed outside a brick building at 202 Luzerne Avenue in Baltimore, Maryland, in March 1929. The photograph was taken approximately four months before Adam married Charles's sister, Sue Catherine Webster, on July 27, 1929.
